notes: a source-account authorization entry whose invocation tree is a single chain 492 invocations deep, at the deepest an envelope decodes at depth 1000. core's own decode accepts 493 levels (auth.invocation.depth); this entry stops at 492 because shapekit's toolkit decode (Type::read_xdr_to_end) spends one depth level on type dispatch and refuses 493 at depth 1000. core's depth check accepts it; the host converts at most 100 levels (scval.depth) and runs at most 100 frames, so an invocation this deep fails and the transaction lands in the ledger as failed with the full tree intact. a decoder must accept it.
